rightsReview.decision: Do not transcribe poster species rows or redistribute poster images until item-specific reuse terms are verified. The public item metadata proves the existence and scope of the summaries, not their license.

evidenceLimits: These are fisheries-summary products, not complete biological surveys or whole-bay species inventories.
The public abstracts describe ranked/focused summaries and size information but do not provide the poster tables as source data.
A summary period does not mean each species was observed in each year or at a verified capture position.
No catchability, current-presence, legal, safety, abundance, or map-point claim is admitted from the metadata review.
nextAction: Verify publisher reuse terms and access to the underlying fishery tables through an authorized route; meanwhile continue independently licensed source review.
